## Why Support?

This project provides **free, open-source AI legal assistance** grounded in the Constitution of India and Indian statutes. Your support helps:

- 🔧 **Maintain** the project and keep it up-to-date
- 📚 **Expand** the legal database (Constitution of India, Central Acts, IPC/BNS, Rules and Notifications)
- 🚀 **Add features** requested by the community
- 🇮🇳 **Support** Indian open-source legal-tech development
- ⚖️ **Democratise** legal tech access for MSMEs and startups

---

## How to Support

Open an issue or start a discussion on [GitHub](https://github.com/ShubhiGoel5/LegalAI/issues) to talk about sponsorship, custom development, or enterprise deployment.

Your support means the world! 🙏
